pages.quiz:
GERMAN — TERMLY EXAM #17 (TERM 2)
====

GRADE: Grade 4
SUBJECT: GERMAN
TIME ALLOWED: 60 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
ASSESSMENT: CBC school-based practice paper

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show your working and write the units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the one best answer.
4. Check your work before you hand in.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. How is the letter K named in German? (1 mark)
   A. ess
   B. bay
   C. kah
   D. vay

2. How is "v" pronounced in "Vater"? (1 mark)
   A. like f
   B. like b
   C. like w
   D. like v

3. What does "Ja" mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. yes
   B. please
   C. good night
   D. sorry, excuse me

4. Which sentence is a question? (1 mark)
   A. Das ist mein Vater.
   B. Wer ist das?
   C. Sie ist nett.
   D. Er ist groß.

5. What does "die Schwester" mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. aunt
   B. sister
   C. daughter
   D. brothers and sisters

6. Which little word goes with the noun "Messer"? (1 mark)
   A. die
   B. den
   C. das
   D. der

7. What does "das Badezimmer" mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. door
   B. bathroom
   C. pot
   D. clock

8. What does "das Wochenende" mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. Sunday
   B. day
   C. week
   D. weekend

9. What does "Gut gemacht!" mean? (1 mark)
   A. Be quiet!
   B. Well done!
   C. See you soon!
   D. One more time!

10. Which day comes right before Sonntag? (1 mark)
   A. Dienstag
   B. Freitag
   C. Samstag
   D. Mittwoch

11. Which German word is the number 12? (1 mark)
   A. zwölf
   B. neun
   C. eins
   D. zwei

12. What does "Seine Freunde kommen" mean? (1 mark)
   A. His friends are singing
   B. His family is leaving
   C. His friends are sleeping
   D. His friends are coming

13. Which food group does "der Kakao" belong to? (1 mark)
   A. die Getränke
   B. das Obst
   C. das Gemüse
   D. das Fleisch

14. Which little word goes with the noun "Tee"? (1 mark)
   A. das
   B. der
   C. den
   D. die

15. What does "der Bauch" mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. tummy
   B. foot
   C. tooth
   D. neck

16. What does "das Auge" mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. mouth
   B. tooth
   C. toe
   D. eye

17. What does "der Regenbogen" mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. cloud
   B. snow
   C. rainbow
   D. fog

18. What does "der Nebel" mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. fog
   B. cloud
   C. sky
   D. thunderstorm

19. What does "tanzen" mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. to have a shower
   B. to sing
   C. to eat
   D. to dance

20. Which German word means "in front of"? (position word) (1 mark)
   A. auf
   B. zwischen
   C. in
   D. vor

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
21. Read and translate: "Wo ist der Ball? Er ist im Garten." (2 marks)

22. Write two sentences in German to say where family members are at home. (3 marks)

23. Explain what reading in chunks means and why it helps. (2 marks)

24. Write in German what you do on Saturday. Start with "Am Samstag". (2 marks)

25. Read aloud and write the sound of these words: Schule, heute, Haus, Tür. (4 marks)

26. Write these numbers in German: 14, 16, 18. (3 marks)

27. Explain why breaking a long word into parts helps you read it. Use Donnerstag as an example. (2 marks)

28. Give three tips for reading a tongue twister well. (3 marks)

29. Read: "Der Herd ist heiß. Das Messer ist scharf." Explain what the text warns about. (2 marks)

30. Read: "Im Wohnzimmer ist ein Sofa. In der Küche ist ein Kühlschrank." Say where each item is in English. (3 marks)

31. Say what "Zum Frühstück trinke ich Tee" means in English. (2 marks)

32. Write the singular and plural of Fuß in German. (2 marks)
pages.answers:
GERMAN — TERMLY EXAM #17 (TERM 2) · MARKING SCHEME
====

SECTION A
----
1. C — kah
   In German the letter K is called kah.

2. A — like f
   In most German words v sounds like f: FAH-ter.

3. A — yes
   Ja means yes.

4. B — Wer ist das?
   Only Wer ist das? asks something.

5. B — sister
   die Schwester means sister.

6. C — das
   It is das Messer, so the little word is das.

7. B — bathroom
   das Badezimmer means bathroom.

8. D — weekend
   das Wochenende means weekend.

9. B — Well done!
   Gut gemacht is praise.

10. C — Samstag
   Before Sonntag comes Samstag.

11. A — zwölf
   12 in German is zwölf.

12. D — His friends are coming
   kommen means to come.

13. A — die Getränke
   der Kakao belongs to die Getränke.

14. B — der
   It is der Tee, so the little word is der.

15. A — tummy
   der Bauch means tummy.

16. D — eye
   das Auge means eye.

17. C — rainbow
   der Regenbogen means rainbow.

18. A — fog
   der Nebel means fog.

19. D — to dance
   tanzen means to dance.

20. D — vor
   in front of in German is vor.

SECTION B
----
21. (2 marks)
   Answer: Where is the ball? It is in the garden.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each sentence.

22. (3 marks)
   Answer: For example: Mama ist in der Küche. Papa ist im Wohnzimmer.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each sentence and 1 mark for correct in der / im.

23. (2 marks)
   Answer: It means reading groups of words together, so your reading sounds smooth.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the meaning and 1 mark for the reason.

24. (2 marks)
   Answer: For example: Am Samstag spiele ich Fußball.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for Am Samstag, 1 mark for a correct sentence.

25. (4 marks)
   Answer: Schule = SHOO-le, heute = HOY-te, Haus = house (ow), Tür = tür (ee with round lips).
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each word.

26. (3 marks)
   Answer: vierzehn, sechzehn, achtzehn.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correctly spelled number.

27. (2 marks)
   Answer: Small parts are easier to say, for example Don-ners-tag.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the reason, 1 mark for the example.

28. (3 marks)
   Answer: Read slowly at first; add a few words at a time; speed up only when it is clear.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each sensible tip.

29. (2 marks)
   Answer: The cooker is hot and the knife is sharp, so we must be careful in the kitchen.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each warning.

30. (3 marks)
   Answer: The sofa is in the living room. The fridge is in the kitchen.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correct place and 1 mark for the items.

31. (2 marks)
   Answer: For breakfast I drink tea.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for breakfast, 1 mark for drink tea.

32. (2 marks)
   Answer: der Fuß, die Füße.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each form.
